messages.author: 142a1d7ed2781f9c
messages.subject: Unable to create png using renjin
parts:
Hey I am trying create png file using renjin ,but it's giving me following error
Object 'Cdevga' not found.


More details ::

  • renjin version > 0.8.2294
  • script > png('test.png')
  • I also tried to use png('test.png',type = 'cairo') .. It gives error Object devCairo not found
  • Stackoverflow Question >> https://stackoverflow.com/questions/40856873/unable-to-create-png-using-renjin


Please let me know if you need more details.


Thanks in advance.

messages.author: f06db63329fab1f9
messages.subject: Re: Unable to create png using renjin
parts:
Hi,
Unfortunately the graphics package is not supported by Renjin at this time. There hasn't been much done in this area as, at least so far, the primary use case for Renjin is computation.

If anyone is interested in picking this up as a project, let me know. It should be pretty doable now that we can directly compile most of the C code in graphics and grDevices to JVM bytecode.

Alex

messages.author: f06db63329fab1f9
messages.subject: Re: Unable to create png using renjin
parts:
That would be fantastic, PL.

The good news is that the progress we've made with our C to JVM compiler and the GNU R emulation layer should make this a very feasible project, though still non-trivial.

Here's a general overview of how I would approach this:
1. Import C and R sources from the graphics and grDevices package from the latest version of GNU R into the following paths:
packages/graphics/src/main/R
packages/graphics/src/main/c
packages/grDevices/src/main/R
packages/grDevices/src/main/c

You can rip out the sources that are currently there.

2. Update the pom.xml files in graphics and grDevices to include a C compilation step, like packages/stats currently does.
3. At some point, you'll want to rip out the grDevices implementation from GNU R like ps, cairo, png, etc, and replace it with an implementation based on java.awt. This will make it possible to use all the Java imaging libraries to generate png, jpeg, tif, ps, svg, etc. 

I don't know exactly what step 3 will look like, but my sense is that grDevices have a relatively small API to implement. 

If you get started with steps 1 and 2 and open a pull request, I can help point you in the right direction from there.

Best,
Alex

messages.author: f06db63329fab1f9
messages.subject: Re: Unable to create png using renjin
parts:
Hi PL,
We are also developing on Ubuntu 16 so that's a good choice!

Have you seen the building instructions here:
https://github.com/bedatadriven/renjin/blob/master/BUILDING.md

On Ubuntu, should be able to install all the required tools using:

sudo apt-get install openjdk-7-jdk maven make gcc-4.7 gcc-4.7-plugin-dev gfortran-4.7 g++-4.7 gcc-4.7.multilib g++-4.7-multilib
If you are still having fortran problems, post error message and the output from "gfortran-4.7 -v" to a gist and share the link here.

Best,
Alex
